transcript.text: Thank you, Dr. Ellis. Here's what I learned from the six-week pilot I conducted with our community partners. The pilot report was just completed this week, and I haven't yet attached it to the approval proposal, but the findings are critical for our decision. First, I verified that students need a full 60 placement hours to achieve the course outcomes we've set — anything less and the learning objectives aren't adequately met. Second, during the pilot, we actually used a faculty-reviewed portfolio as the assessment method rather than a final reflective essay, and it proved far more effective for evaluating students' community work and academic reflection together. So I'd recommend we update the proposal to reflect both the 60-hour placement requirement and the portfolio-based assessment before finalizing the operating details.
